preconditions.description: The number of objects in the ski resort is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each object is either a hotel (type_i = 1) or a mountain (type_i = 0).

preconditions.expression: at least one object is a hotel
preconditions.description: There is at least one hotel in the ski resort.
The ski track information is within the bounds of the number of objects.

postconditions.description: The path length is at least 1.
The path ends at a hotel.
The path consists of mountains except for the last hotel.

postconditions.expression: all(a_{v_i} == v_{i+1} for i in range(k-1))
postconditions.description: There is a ski track from each mountain to the next in the path.
The path length is the maximum possible given the constraints.
